intro: Twelve articles published between 2026-04-12 and 2026-10-06 examine Iran-related cyber activity. CHOSEN BRICK, APT33, and CL-STA-1178 appear among the top threat actors covered. Reporting spans government, water, critical infrastructure, energy, and telecommunications as the most affected sectors. The United states, Iran, the Middle east, Netherlands, and United kingdom rank among the top affected regions. Ten of the twelve articles carry a high severity rating, reflecting the weight of incidents documented across this period.
